author: Michael Waters
text:
Ethan Parsons was a timely, professional plumber whose knowledge and execution surpassed my expectations as a customer.  Champion Plumbing is very lucky to have him on their team.

He cleared the blockage, explained the issue, how to remedy, and assured us no damage was done to the pipes in the process using a camera.

5/5 stars, I’d highly recommend Ethan P and Champion plumbing.  This is not my first time using Champion, and each time they’ve gone further than other plumbers would over the years.  I am happy to be a customer.

author: Gordon Chandler
text: I've used Champion twice now and have recommended them to friends several times. They came out quickly to my house, got me in contact with a water restoration company within a few hours, and had my hot water heater reinstalled quickly. Thomas was the plumber who came out and he did a great job. He was professional, courteous, respectful of our home, and was great with our dogs. I really appreciate the hard work he did, especially in the attic when it was so hot. Thank you!

author: Becknd Latham
text: Very good service. Had Chase and Ethan out to repair a leak. They were very professional and courteous, explained everything so that a layman like me could easily understand the repair that was needed. They recommended a water damage mitigation service who also worked very well with us. Can't say one bad word about the company or the guys.

author: Robin Wilson
text:
Chase and Josh were great.  Replaced garbage disposal then checked any previous work done at the property by the company!
Ethan has done several jobs for us including replacing hot water tanks and working with well company during pump replacement!  Guys were all great

author: Teagan Hawkins
text: Ethan Patton did a great job. Quick, convenient, and professional service.
